profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I have over 13 years of software development experience.  I started my career at Vanguard, doing Java development for financial back end services, worked as a consultant with Mulesoft, creating custom REST services for clients.  Recently I have done Java and Flutter/Dart UI development for application screens.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Peloton Group is a leading professional services firm that specializes in envisioning and implementing high-value enterprise performance management (EPM) and business intelligence (BI) initiatives. We partner with clients in the planning and execution of business and technology initiatives focused on driving insight and analytics. We ensure our clients have access to the right information, at the right time, to make key business decisions.

At Peloton Group, we pride ourselves on our ability to partner with clients to efficiently develop solutions that drive measurable results and achieve optimal performance!

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Mid-tier Java development with REST services. Refactoring legacy code into a service oriented architecture. Automating the test suite.

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description: Develop a web application with Java and Scala.  Write Bash scripts to setup local databases for testing. Tested and automated tests for the web application.
